programme.desc: I'm Goin' to Praiseland: Ned opens a Christian amusement park. At first, the tame religious attractions are unpopular. But then visitors start having visions...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Simpsons Tall Tales: A hobo regales the family with unique takes on classic American tales starring the Simpsons as Connie Appleseed, Paul Bunyan and Tom Sawyer.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Come Fly with Me: Jay reluctantly takes Phil out to fly his new model plane, but a manoeuvre goes awry...

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The Incident: Claire and Mitchell's mother, Dede, drops in for a surprise visit and is determined to make amends with everyone who she offended during 'the incident'.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Coming to Homerica: When nearby Ogdenville's unemployed come to Springfield looking for jobs, Mayor Quimby shuts the town's borders and enlists private citizens to guard them.

programme.title: Celebrity Coach Trip
programme.desc: It's the end of the first week and Brendan has a twist up his sleeve. The celebs tackle pottery in Porto, before an argument threatens to send one couple packing.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Wife Aquatic: The family visit Barnacle Bay, where Marge grew up, but discover that it's become run-down. Can Homer help to clean up the town?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Wayz We Were: Evergreen Terrace becomes one giant traffic jam thanks to a new GPS app. Moe reunites with an old flame - and this time he's determined to not screw it up.
